items.detail: The **S&P 500** slipped 0.17% on Tuesday and the Nasdaq dipped 0.09% to 26,797.54, a quiet follow-up to Monday's selloff.
items.why: A consumer confidence slump, record-high long yields and doubts over Anthropic's leaked IPO filing kept buyers cautious.

items.detail: Odds of an October Fed hike fell to about **51.5%** from roughly 71% on Monday. This week's PCE and jobs reports could still swing them back.
items.why: Consumer confidence hit its lowest level since 2014, and the New York Fed's Williams said there was no need to rush.

items.detail: The **30-year Treasury yield** hit 5.612% during Tuesday's session, its highest since 2002, after rising for a sixth straight day. The 10-year held near 5.25%.
items.why: Inflation fears and heavy corporate bond issuance kept pressure on long-dated government debt.

items.detail: Asian stocks rose Wednesday after three losing sessions. The MSCI Asia Pacific index gained 0.4% and Korea's **Kospi** rose 0.65%.
items.why: Brent fell 2.6% to $102.59 as Middle East oil exports recovered and the US offered to sell emergency reserve oil.

items.detail: India's **Nifty 50** recovered from early losses to close down only 0.28% at **22,716.20** on Tuesday, then traded flat Wednesday morning.
items.why: Falling oil prices helped stocks bounce off the day's lows, though property shares dropped 2%.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** has trailed the S&P 500 by about **10 percentage points** this quarter, its biggest gap since 2020.
items.why: The prospect of more Fed hikes and yields above 5% raises borrowing costs for small companies with heavy debt.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** slipped under 1% to about $83,100 on Tuesday and stayed near Monday's weekly low of $82,630. US spot bitcoin ETFs have now taken in more than they lost this year.
items.why: A 10-year yield near 5.25% outweighed last week's $2.4 billion of ETF inflows.

items.detail: **Ether** edged up to about **$2,690**, above Monday's $2,646, but stayed below its $2,800 ceiling.
items.why: Cheaper oil and lower Fed hike bets gave some relief, while record-high long yields held gains back.

items.detail: **Solana** fell to about **$119.50**, down roughly 2.6% from Monday, lagging BTC and ETH this time.
items.why: Traders took profits after a 68% two-month rally that had brought Solana nearly back to even for 2026.

items.detail: **Spot gold** rose 1.4% to about $4,172 on Tuesday, recovering from Monday's selloff, and held near **$4,180** on Wednesday.
items.why: Weak job openings and consumer confidence data cut October hike bets, though high yields limited the rebound.

crossCuttingTheme: Oil's retreat and weak US data cut October hike odds to about 51%, lifting gold and Asian stocks, but 30-year yields at their highest since 2002 kept US stocks, small caps and crypto from recovering.
